topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: Immediate services require on-board storage capacity to store data packets before operation. Time-tagged services, which must be started after upload completion, may not exceed available on-board memory, thus influencing payload power allocation. This constraint limits the amount of power allocated to each service based on its priority.
reference_context: The provided text describes the constraints related to satellite communication systems and their operation. It highlights the impact of these constraints on resource allocation for different types of services, including immediate and time-tagged ones.
